notes: HarleyDroid documents J1850 diagnostic requests and broadcast signals discovered on Harley motorcycles, notably Sportster. Exact model/year compatibility varies. This GuzziOnBoard integration has synthetic tests only and has not been tested on a motorcycle. ELM327 serial at 38400 baud, read-only; no flash, fault clear or service commands.

session.physical_evidence_note: HarleyDroid uses J1850 VPW via ELM327 on Harley bikes, notably Sportster. This integration is not hardware-tested.

memory.write_blocked_reason: HarleyDroid diagnostic queries do not implement ECU calibration reading or programming.
